title: Interactive Point
summary: Pickable 3D point helper with billboarded coordinate label and optional color control module.

vr_notes.comfort: Label text follows the point smoothly without extra animations.
vr_notes.interaction: Compatible with XR pick-up logic exposed by GrabSphere.
vr_notes.performance: Single mesh + label; negligible cost even in dense scenes.

parameters.name: set_point_position
parameters.description: Moves the point/label to a new world position.

parameters.name: set_point_color
parameters.description: Applies a color via PointColor or emissive material fallback.

parameters.name: set_label_visible
parameters.description: Toggles the coordinate label on or off.
